I found a problem that I shouldn't resolve by guessing: Cobalt Labs has **two** approved invoices, not one.

| Invoice | Amount | Due | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-30444 | $3,714.45 | 2026-11-04 | approved |
| INV-51862 | $6,764.82 | 2026-11-25 | approved |
| INV-43342 | $3,629.40 | 2026-11-28 | draft — awaiting approval (not payable) |
| INV-84090 | $6,578.62 | 2026-09-30 | paid |

I did not send any payment, because "Cobalt Labs's approved invoice" is ambiguous between INV-30444 and INV-51862, and a wire can't be un-sent cleanly. I also confirmed there are currently **no payments** in the operating account, so nothing has been paid against either invoice yet (no duplicate risk to correct).

Additional context: the vendor (V-186) is bank-verified and supports both wire and ACH, so either rail is available. Both amounts are under the $10,000 controller-approval threshold, and neither would require approver routing.

**Which invoice should I pay?** Options:
1. INV-30444 — $3,714.45
2. INV-51862 — $6,764.82
3. Both, in separate payments ($10,479.27 total — this would cross the $10k threshold and need controller approval)

Once you tell me which, I'll pay it exactly once by wire (falling back to ACH only if wire is unavailable) and report the payment ID back to you.
